A positive impulse response covers overdamped dynamics, while a nonzero sinusoid dominates when \(q>\beta\). The first-negative-lag limit follows from bounds differing by at most one oscillator period. The exact witness is elementary; standalone finite testing passed 2015 diagnostics. The analytical argument, not these diagnostics, establishes the infinite assertions.
